text:
mona: Heads up — we got a short spike of 502s hitting hosted-api edge at 2024-11-12 14:32:10 UTC. Customer reports streaming timeouts and 502 body.
jordan: saw it in SLO alert, spike lasted ~90s, aggregated 1.8% of requests for eu1 frontdoor.
mona: auth rotation happened ~14:32:05 (tenant token swap). Can we correlate?
lia: pulling edge logs now. Early sign: upstream envoy reported '503 no healthy upstream' and nginx 502 on auth-backend.
opsbot: alert acked by jordan
jordan: sample trace id: trace-acme-0x6f7a — envoy upstream reset, auth backend returned 500 then closed conn.
mona: can someone run a quick curl against auth to repro?
lia: curl sample:
```
curl -v 'https://auth.internal.redwood/api/v1/validate' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <ROTATING_TOKEN>' -d '{"tenant": "acme"}'
```
lia: getting 500/connection reset when using token from rotation window.
jordan: looks like auth pod did a staggered restart during key rotation; readiness probe lagged -> connection window drained.
support_lead: customer workaround: retry with exponential backoff, fallback to non-streaming path. Sent to customer.
mona: mitigation — temporarily disabled aggressive key rotation for tenant acme and scaled auth replicas + rolling restart slower.
deploy-bot: rolling restart initiated for auth-service eu1 at 14:34 UTC (change set id: cs-7891)
lia: post-mitigation metrics show 502 rate back to baseline, latency normalized. Keep an eye for recurrence.
jordan: adding a postmortem note and repro steps to support ticket. Assigning follow-up to SRE runway to add circuit-breaker/backoff + readiness tuning.
support_lead: thanks team. I'll update the customer and close the escalation once we confirm 24h stability. :thumbsup:
